title: The Clever Fox
text:
Once upon a time, there was a little fox. The fox lived in a forest near a river. He was hungry every day. One morning, he saw a red apple on a tall tree.

The fox wanted the apple, but it was too high for him. He asked a wise owl for help. The owl said, "Be patient and think." The fox thought about it and jumped. He got the apple.

options: In a forest near a river

Why did the fox need help?
options: He was too tired to walk

options: It was unkind to the fox
It gave the fox good advice
It was afraid of the fox

paragraph_translations: Era uma vez uma pequena raposa. A raposa morava em uma floresta perto de um rio. Ela sentia fome todos os dias. Uma manhã, viu uma maçã vermelha em uma árvore alta.
A raposa queria a maçã, mas ela estava alta demais para ela. Pediu ajuda a uma coruja sábia. A coruja disse: "Seja paciente e pense." A raposa pensou e pulou. Ela pegou a maçã.
